boundary.description: targets binds direct entities; task is the whole runtime task; each is an open universal class; implementation is generation, not runtime behavior. Only and/or/not containers use composite.

members.description: atom/opaque: empty; and/or: at least two; not: exactly one. Requirement IDs, one parent per member, no cycles; parent and members share modality.

references.description: Entity IDs used as references/comparators; mention alone does not make an entity a direct target.

target_class.description: Nonempty open class for each; null for every other boundary.

targets.description: Entity IDs. Empty for task, implementation and composite. Nonempty for targets; at most one enclosing entity for each.
